items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I played guitar with Charlie Galloway for a while... I believe I played with his band about two, three years. Charlie Galloway was a bass player and he was the leader of the band.

ctx.x: Did you know Charlie? He played with all of us. Hmm? He played with all of us. Yeah. Uh huh. What about Charlie Galloway? Did you know him? Charlie Galloway, I worked with, uh,

I played guitar with Charlie Galloway for a while, not too long. I believe I played with his band about two, three years. That's about all. Charlie Galloway was a bass player and he was the leader of the band. He had one leg, walked with a crutch. And he had a good Dixieland band, jazz band. And I played, I remember playing with him a while, you know. Was he an older man than you or younger? Oh yeah, he was, uh, he was younger than me. Yeah. Who was in his band? Well, uh, they had, uh, some of the old fellas out…

Cripple Pill. Oh yeah. He would have told us about Cripple Pill, uh, uh, Henry Ross. Henry Ross. I didn't know his right name, but all we know was Pill. Crowback? Yeah. They're called him Crowback, too. That's the same guy? And, uh, uh, uh, uh. Were there any other? Oh, go ahead. Let's see this boy's name now. A guitar player. A famous guitar player. He was a golf, uh, uh, uh, can't think of his name.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: I even played a couple jobs with them, with Galloway. I played guitar with Galloway.

ctx.x: Well, you'd remember, uh, did you remember bands like the Galloway band?
Galloway, yes. I even played a couple jobs with them, with Galloway. I played guitar with Galloway. He was the one-legged bass player.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: They had the Charlie Galloway's band. ... Yeah, Charlie Galloway. Yeah.

ctx.x: I was going to ask a little bit more. I don't want to bother you a lot of questions, but I wondered when you were a boy, who the bands were you heard when you were a boy, even before you took up music?

Were there any brass bands or parades or dance bands you remember? No. Yeah, yeah. Most of the time was just string instruments, see? And, well, of all the bands I played with was full bands. Yes. I mean, even before you took up music, do you remember going to any dances or hearing any music? Oh, yes. I used to go to dances. Do you remember which bands you played? Well, practically most all they had the Blazer Way band. They had the Charlie Galloway's band. And they had the Silver Leaf band. Yeah. They used to…
What was this band? Ms. Cole, Ms. Cole's lawn garden up there on Magnolia Street. You mentioned, was that called Blaze Away band? What was that? I never heard of that before.
